module: Manager of the 3D checkpoint markers of a scenario race. It creates one marker per waypoint with the chosen type (module scenario/raceMarkers/<type>, sideColumnMarker by default), hides or shows them, sets their mode (current, next, hidden...) and updates them every frame. The markers are hidden in photo mode.
notes: M.idToMarker is copied at export: clearMarkerList reassigns the local variable idToMarker, so M.idToMarker no longer follows the table actually used after a first cleanup.
In setupMarkers, marker:createMarkers() is called twice per marker (once in createRaceMarker, once afterwards).
The modes passed to setModes are mode names specific to each marker type (see scenario/raceMarkers/*); a waypoint absent from the table receives 'hidden'.
The global variable photoModeOpen is read to hide the markers.

idToMarker.desc: Table id -> marker, initial copy of the internal table (see notes).

createRaceMarker.desc: Creates a marker of the given type (or the current type by default), calls createMarkers() and, unless detached, registers it for updates and hiding.

detached.desc: If true, the marker is not managed by this module (no automatic update).

type.desc: Module name in scenario/raceMarkers/, for example 'ringMarker'.

init.desc: Clears the previous markers and hides those that remain.

setupMarkers.desc: Chooses the marker type then creates one marker per waypoint and places it on its checkpoint (setToCheckpoint). The old markers are removed first. The markers are indexed by wp.name.

wps.desc: List of waypoints, each with a name field.

marker.desc: Module name in scenario/raceMarkers/; nil for the default type sideColumnMarker.

render.desc: To be called every frame: hides the markers in photo mode (and restores them on exit), otherwise calls marker:update(dt, dtSim) on each.

setModes.desc: Sets the mode of each marker from a table waypoint name -> mode; absent names go to 'hidden'.

setToCheckpoints.desc: Places each marker back on the checkpoint data matching its name.

drawOnMinimap.desc: Asks each marker that supports it (drawOnMinimap) to draw itself on the minimap.

td.desc: Drawing context passed as is to the markers (inferred from code).

onClientEndMission.desc: Mission end hook: removes the markers and resets the marker type to default.
